name: Paik/Abe Folding Amplifier (Artistic Interpretation)
description: Triangle wave folding amplifier inspired by audio synthesis wavefolders. NOT present in actual Paik/Abe schematics.

authenticity.reason: No 'folding amplifier' circuit exists in Paik/Abe schematics. The actual colorization is done by CA3019 amplitude window detection (PED Control, Page 28). The 'folding' terminology came from loose descriptions of nonlinear behavior.
authenticity.schematic_basis: None - creative interpretation based on audio synthesis concepts
authenticity.notes: Similar to Serge/Buchla wavefolders from audio synthesis. Produces interesting effects but via different mechanism than authentic Paik/Abe.

artistic_value.visual_character: Creates luminance-dependent banding patterns similar to solarization
artistic_value.note: When used before PED Colorizer, creates more complex patterns

future.reason: Useful creative tool, could become generic 'Video Wavefolder' module
